themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Missed garbage collection complaints spiked to 7 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.4 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 409% increase (z-score: 3.99)—signaling a sudden service degradation in Riverdale/Fieldston's sanitation system.
evidence: 7 missed collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (409% spike)
Z-score of 3.99 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Heat/hot water (3,426 complaints) and illegal parking (3,254 complaints) remain top volume issues but are chronic; missed collection is acute
reporting_angles: Interview sanitation department about staffing shortages or route changes affecting CD 208 this week
Canvass residents on multiple blocks to confirm pileup patterns and interview affected households

themes_detail.label: Pigeon Infestation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary pigeon condition complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK from a baseline of 0.2 per week—a 1100% spike (z-score: 6.35)—marking the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset and suggesting a new public health or urban wildlife problem.
evidence: 3 unsanitary pigeon complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% spike)
Z-score of 6.35—highest statistical severity in entire dataset
Concentrated spike suggests localized event (contaminated food source, roosting site, or removal of deterrents)
reporting_angles: Identify specific blocks with pigeon complaints and investigate for new food vendors, open dumpsters, or removed anti-roosting spikes
Interview Parks Department about pigeon management protocols and recent changes in CD 208

themes_detail.label: Dangling Street Signs
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street sign complaints hit 3 LAST WEEK versus a baseline of 0.2 per week—a 1100% increase (z-score: 4.16)—indicating sudden infrastructure deterioration or a specific maintenance backlog in traffic/directional signage.
evidence: 3 dangling street sign complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% spike)
Z-score of 4.16 indicates high statistical significance
Overlaps with 'Overgrown Tree/Branches' spike (3 last week vs. 0.5 avg, 500% increase) suggesting wind or storm damage
reporting_angles: Photograph affected signs and file DOT complaint to trigger response timeline
Cross-reference with Department of Environmental Protection records for recent weather events (wind, ice) that may have damaged signage

themes_detail.label: Lead Exposure Risk Spike
themes_detail.summary: Lead complaints jumped to 5 TWO WEEKS AGO from a baseline of 1.4 per week—a 264% increase (z-score: 5.21)—raising concerns about water quality, lead paint, or construction-related contamination in a neighborhood with aging housing stock.
evidence: 5 lead complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (264% spike)
Z-score of 5.21 indicates statistically significant public health signal
Riverdale/Fieldston has substantial pre-1950 housing stock vulnerable to lead paint and service line corrosion
reporting_angles: Investigate whether lead complaints cluster by street/building type; interview DEP about recent water quality tests or known contamination
Interview pediatrician or public health advocate about lead screening rates in CD 208 and outreach to families in affected buildings

themes_detail.label: Derelict Vehicle Accumulation
themes_detail.summary: Derelict vehicle complaints surged to 18 TWO WEEKS AGO versus a baseline of 7.8 per week—a 132% increase (z-score: 4.04)—indicating either a towing enforcement gap or a new pattern of vehicle abandonment in the district.
evidence: 18 derelict vehicle complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 7.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (132% spike)
Illegal parking (3,254 complaints, 90-day total) is top-three volume issue; derelict vehicle spike suggests enforcement variance
reporting_angles: Map the 18 derelict vehicle complaints to identify hotspot neighborhoods and interview NYPD Towing about response delays
Interview residents on affected blocks about how long vehicles sit abandoned before removal and community impact
